title: pm-dispatch: `pm:epic` marks every card an epic reserves — never with `pm:queue`
body:
Fixes #15666

**Governed surface (`.claude/**`) — draft PR, human merge.** No seat flips it ready, enqueues it, arms auto-merge, or approves it. `skip-changeset`: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (`.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`).

## What changes, and why only this

The maintainer's rulings stay verbatim on the card (no dates, quotations or card numbers enter the file): the reservation an epic holds must be visible on every reserved card in the list page, and reusing `pm:epic` on the sub-issues instead of a new label was accepted. This PR writes that meaning into exactly the three surfaces the card names:

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — section「Epic 子树车道」: the five rules, one line each, paid inside the section (811 of 811 lines; ceiling untouched; every line ≤120 bytes).
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — the `pm:epic` row of the label table.
3. `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` — the `pm:epic` description only (98 characters against the 100 cap). Repo list untouched — the loop already seeds all five repos including `cloud`; no credentials logic.

Deliberately untouched, per the rulings: `references/core-rules.md` (the digest carries no epic line today), `references/state-machine.md`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (the two patrol rows are the sibling card #15667, filed in the same act), every other SKILL.md section, every ratchet row and pin.

## Before → after

### Section「Epic 子树车道」(SKILL.md lines 298–311; the angle-bracket placeholder in the `epic:` argument is spelled `N` here and is unchanged in the file)

Before — 14 rule lines:

```text
- 大开发(父单 + sub-issue 树)整体委托一个专职 PM 会话:`/pm-dispatch epic:#N`。   (97 B)
- 队列 = 子树 open 未认领 sub-issue,每轮重读不缓存。   (67 B)
- 委托信号成对落地:父单打 `pm:epic` + 正文写会话 ID 与声明的文件领地。   (95 B)
- 其它 PM 的候选获取跳过整棵子树。   (48 B)
- 域座位批次选择时读一次 `label:pm:epic` 索引,避开领地相交。   (80 B)
- epic PM 不同时持有 `domain:*` 座位;认领纪律全套照做。   (71 B)
- 触 `packages/spec` 的 sub-issue 照旧转 spec 座位。   (60 B)
- 衍生问题三分法,判据:不修它,epic 验收过不过得去。   (70 B)
- in-scope ⇒ 挂父单 sub-issue 下轮自动入队。   (56 B)
- 触 spec/公共契约 ⇒ 转 spec 座位队列,epic 侧写 `Blocked-by:`。   (78 B)
- 顺带发现 ⇒ 独立立单进修复落地仓 backlog,查重先行。   (73 B)
- ⛔ 不借 sub-issue 通道把未分诊的卡塞进池子。   (62 B)
- 每次分流留一行审计评论;父单维护 checklist 汇总评论,决策仍锚在具体 sub-issue。   (106 B)
- 收尾四步、僵尸回收与领地防撞细则见 `references/seat-post-protocol.md`。   (91 B)
```

After — 14 rule lines:

```text
- 大开发(父单 + sub-issue 树)整体委托一个专职 PM 会话:`/pm-dispatch epic:#N`。   (97 B)
- 委托信号成对落地:父单打 `pm:epic` + 正文写会话 ID 与声明的文件领地。   (95 B)
- epic 立卡挂父单、打 `pm:epic`,⛔ 永不 `pm:queue`;`label:pm:epic` 即父子保留全集,域座位不取。   (117 B)
- 队列 = 子树 open 未认领 sub-issue,每轮重读不缓存;其它 PM 候选获取跳过整棵子树。   (108 B)
- 域座位批次选择读一次 `label:pm:epic` 索引,避开领地相交;epic PM 不兼任 `domain:*` 座位。   (113 B)
- 认领纪律全套照做:先写标签、再 `Claim:`、再全线程重读;认领后 `pm:epic` 留在卡上。   (111 B)
- 离开子树(交车道或转 spec 座位)同一笔标签写摘 `pm:epic` 加 `pm:queue`。   (92 B)
- `pm:epic` + `pm:queue` 同卡 = 半状态(保留兼移交);后者即已移交,取回走全套认领协议含重读。   (119 B)
- 单车道仓(无 `domain:*`)开卡即认领合法;多车道仓域标签前置照旧,子树标记即保留。   (110 B)
- 衍生问题三分,判据:不修它 epic 验收过不过得去;in-scope ⇒ 挂父单 sub-issue 下轮自动入队。   (119 B)
- 触 `packages/spec`/公共契约(sub-issue 或衍生)⇒ 照旧转 spec 座位队列,epic 侧写 `Blocked-by:`。   (115 B)
- 顺带发现 ⇒ 独立立单进修复落地仓,查重先行;⛔ 不借 sub-issue 通道塞未分诊卡进池子。   (117 B)
- 每次分流留一行审计评论;父单维护 checklist 汇总评论,决策仍锚在具体 sub-issue。   (106 B)
- 收尾四步、僵尸回收与领地防撞细则见 `references/seat-post-protocol.md`。   (91 B)
```

### Label-table row (SKILL.md line 118)

- Before: `` | `pm:epic`(父单) | 子树已委托 epic PM;其它 PM 不把其 sub-issue 当候选 | `` — 87 bytes
- After: `` | `pm:epic`(父单或 sub-issue) | 已由 epic PM 保留;其它 PM 永不取;⛔ 永不与 `pm:queue` 同挂 | `` — 110 bytes (the file's widest row stays the `domain:engine` row at 342, pin unchanged)

### Label description (`scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the `pm:epic` line)

- Before: `Parent delegated to a dedicated epic PM — other PMs never dispatch into its subtree` — 83 characters
- After: `Reserved by a dedicated epic PM, parent or sub-issue; other PMs never take it; never with pm:queue` — 98 characters (cap 100, measured in code points as the gate does)

## Rule inventory — one row per surviving line (E1–E14 = the 14 pre-existing rules in file order; N1–N5 = the card's five)

| after | bytes | carries | merged / changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 97 | E1 | verbatim |
| 2 | 95 | E3 | verbatim (moved up one slot so the delegation pair reads together) |
| 3 | 117 | N1 | new: cards hang under the parent and carry `pm:epic`, ⛔ never `pm:queue`; `label:pm:epic` is the whole reserved set, parents and children; domain seats never take one |
| 4 | 108 | E2 + E4 | queue definition + other PMs skip the whole subtree; only the particle 的 dropped |
| 5 | 113 | E5 + E6 (first clause) | batch selection reads the `label:pm:epic` index + epic PM holds no `domain:*` seat; 选择时→选择, 不同时持有→不兼任 |
| 6 | 111 | N2 + E6 (second clause) | E6's 认领纪律全套照做 kept verbatim as the head; then the pair as written: label write, `Claim:`, full-thread re-read; `pm:epic` stays after the claim |
| 7 | 92 | N3 | new: leaving the subtree (to a lane, or to the spec seat) removes `pm:epic` and adds `pm:queue` in one label write |
| 8 | 119 | N4 | new: `pm:epic` + `pm:queue` on one card is a half-state (reserved and handed over at once); `pm:queue` means handed over; taking back = full claim protocol incl. the re-read |
| 9 | 110 | N5 | new: single-lane repos (no `domain:*`) may open-and-claim in one act; multi-lane repos keep the domain-label prerequisite, the subtree marker is the reservation |
| 10 | 119 | E8 + E9 | trichotomy criterion + in-scope ⇒ sub-issue under the parent, auto-enqueued next round; 三分法→三分, one comma dropped |
| 11 | 115 | E7 + E10 | the two spec lines were one rule twice: sub-issues or derived work touching `packages/spec`/public contract go to the spec seat queue, epic side writes `Blocked-by:`; now one ⇒ branch of the trichotomy |
| 12 | 117 | E11 + E12 | incidental findings ⇒ separate card in the fix-landing repo, dedupe first + ⛔ never push untriaged cards into the pool through the sub-issue channel; 「backlog」and two particles dropped |
| 13 | 106 | E13 | verbatim |
| 14 | 91 | E14 | verbatim (the pointer to `references/seat-post-protocol.md`) |

All 14 pre-existing rules survive; the section's one pre-existing ⛔ (E12) survives; two ⛔ are added (line 3, the table row). Five lines paid by six joins (E6 is split across lines 5 and 6), net 0 lines in the file.

## Gates — all run on the merged head `edc6d1226` after the final commit; exit codes captured before any pipe; each gate's own verdict line quoted

- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, whole tree — no narrowing to declare) through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` — `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 110s` on `edc6d1226` (and command-exit 0, held 120s, on the pre-merge commit `718c718a5`); shared-box seconds, not idle-box figures.

A whole-tree family over `content/docs` formula expressions, which this diff does not touch.
